description: Header file defining the Request class and related performance tracking classes within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, including request states, modes, and JSON-RPC tracking.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/Web request with state and mode, providing methods to determine call type and manage request lifecycle.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing performance statistics collection and retrieval for request processing.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics
classes.description: Holds statistical data and provides methods to clear, add, and access performance metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::DataSet
classes.description: Structure holding individual performance timing metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::Tuple
classes.description: Aggregates timing data, providing min, max, average, and count, with methods to measure and clear data.

classes.name: TrackingJSONRPC
classes.description: Class for tracking JSON-RPC request timing and statistics, inheriting from Web::JSONRPC::Body.

methods.name: Request::RestfulCall
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the RESTful prefix path.

methods.name: Request::JSONRPCCall
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the JSONRPC prefix path.

methods.name: Request::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the request.

methods.name: Request::Service
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated Service proxy.

methods.name: Request::Set
methods.description: Sets error code, service, and mode for the request.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::In
methods.description: Records incoming data size and updates deserialization timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Out
methods.description: Records outgoing data size and updates communication timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Acquire
methods.description: Marks the start of request processing for timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Relinquish
methods.description: Finalizes timing data and stores performance metrics.
